correctness.rationale: Complete matchings are in bijection with fixed-point-free involutions via their one-line permutations, and each lower cell is an ordered subsequence, not an unordered support. The deletion faces give the cellular differential, including augmentation to the empty word; characteristic two makes each two-position deletion occur twice and cancel. A separate exact Python replay, not the supplied program, generated 1, 3, 15 and 105 full words and reproduced both conventions for computing the boundary ranks. For n=8 the cell counts were (8,56,336,1680,3612,2677,840,105) and ranks were (1,7,49,287,1385,1933,735,105), beginning at degree zero. Rank-nullity on the augmented complex gave the complete Betti vectors (0,0), (0,1,1,0), (0,0,3,19,0,0), and (0,0,0,8,294,9,0,0). These are all even sizes up to and including 8, so the first occurrence follows without extrapolation.
residual_risks: Only reduced F2 homology is certified; integral torsion, homotopy type, and behavior beyond the first occurrence are not determined.

evidence: General permutation-complex results include the two-generator case; the fundamental-group theorem gives freeness without these ranks. The pattern-avoiding theorem concerns different generators. The cycle-packing result actually applies to fixed-point-free involutions and gives a common lower skeleton and low-degree vanishing.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Credit the low-degree zeros obtained from the common skeleton, including through degree two at n=8. Connectivity and general freeness do not determine the three positive ranks; the relevant positive entries are strictly above that vanishing range at n=8.

value.rationale: The double-transposition-type generalization to all perfect matchings is a natural uniform conjugacy-class family of permutation complexes. The calculation is bounded by a meaningful first-occurrence criterion rather than by a claim of convenience at n=8. The precise three-degree onset establishes a concrete obstruction to models predicting homology supported only in one or two degrees for this family, and the full vectors distinguish the smaller sizes and give tests for future structural formulas.
residual_risks: The value judgment does not assume integral or large-n consequences.
